# BLO-48145 — raise env-guard.test.ts per-test timeout to 30 s

Tracking: [BLO-48145](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/BLO/issues/BLO-48145)

Test-only. `src/server/env-guard.test.ts` now calls
`vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 30_000 })` at file scope. Most cases in that file
spawn real node processes (the BLO-29965 "never calls the API…" case spawns ten
in a row), so their wall time follows runner load rather than the code under
test. Under CI load the 5 s vitest default timed out the BLO-29965 suite on PRs
that do not touch this tree and ejected merge-queue entries. Reproduced locally
at 2×nproc busy-loops: 30 spawn tests failed, including single-spawn cases in
"embedded guard script (real node process)", which is why the timeout applies to
the whole file rather than one `describe`.

No assertion changed. A genuine hang still fails, at 30 s: every network call
the guard makes is capped at 10 s by `AbortSignal.timeout` in `env-guard.ts`.
No vendored source under `src/` other than this test file changed.
